assertions.assertion: Creates a named instance with StorageInstanceId.Create(...)
Registers the second database with AddStorage(instanceId, storage => ...) and maps operational data with AddOperationalStorage(instanceId)
Keeps AddStorage(...)+AddConfigurationStorage() for the default instance
Migrates every instance via IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory.GetStorageInstanceSchema(id, ct).MigrateAsync, noting IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync only migrates the default instance
assertions.rationale: No IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory; uses dotnet ef migrations.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that mapping one category to two different instances or selecting a second provider for one instance throws InvalidOperationException
assertions.rationale: No mention of InvalidOperationException for double mapping.
